newsitem.title: UK: Mercury, Schroders jump on bid talk.
newsitem.headline: Mercury, Schroders jump on bid talk.

text.p: Shares in Mercury Asset Management Plc and Schroders Plc added to last week gains and jumped to record levels amid persistent bid rumours, dealers said.
By 1036 GMT, Mercury shares advanced 20p to 1376, while Schroders shares climbed 17-1/2p to 1770.
Bid talk carried the shares higher last week, and a weekend press report saying that Merrill Lynch was eyeing the two firms propelled shares this morning.
Merrill Lynch was not immediately available to comment today. On Friday, the investment bank said it would not comment on market speculation.
Dealers said bid talk heated up after U.S. investment banks Morgan Stanley Group Inc and Dean Witter Discover & Co last week announced their plans to merge.
"That merger seemed to refocus attention on the idea that there will be more consolidation in this industry," said one.
